description:
Ask to be told when something happens: each matching event is POSTed as JSON to your https URL within seconds. Create one, or change one by id — saving also resumes a paused webhook.

Events are thin: a type, a stable id, the workspace, product and account, and the ids to look things up by — never the comment or message text. On comment.created, read it with comments_list comment_id and answer with comments_reply or messages_reply comment_id before privateReplyUntil. On message.received, read the thread with messages_list conversation_id and answer before replyUntil.

Answer 2xx within 10 seconds. A failed delivery is retried three times over about twenty minutes, so the same event id can arrive more than once: ignore ids you have already handled. Only comments and messages from the last day are announced.

auth_header is sent as the Authorization header on every delivery, for an endpoint that expects a credential (e.g. "Bearer …"). It is stored encrypted and never shown again; null removes it.

account_id.description: Only events about this account, from accounts_list. null for every account.

id.description: An existing webhook to change, from webhooks_list.

product_id.description: Only events about this product, from products_list. null for every product.

workspace_id.description: Which workspace, when you are in several and give no product or account.

name: webhooks_save
title: Save a webhook
